blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in Deepdene in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive breakdown of kitchen renovation costs in Deepdene, including cabinetry, benchtops, labour, and design fees for Melbourne's inner east.
body: If you are a Deepdene homeowner considering a kitchen renovation, understanding the true cost is the essential first step. Kitchen renovation prices in Deepdene and Melbourne's inner eastern suburbs typically range from $15,000 for a straightforward cosmetic refresh to $60,000 or more for a complete luxury transformation with custom cabinetry. The final price depends on several key factors including the size of your kitchen, the complexity of the layout, the materials you select, and whether structural changes are required. At Total Support Kitchen and Home Renovation, we have completed hundreds of kitchen projects across Deepdene, and we believe in full transparency when it comes to pricing your renovation.

The largest portion of any kitchen renovation budget goes toward cabinetry, typically accounting for 40 to 50 percent of the total cost. In Deepdene, homeowners who opt for custom Australian-made cabinetry manufactured locally with premium materials can expect to invest between $8,000 and $25,000 depending on the number of cabinets, the complexity of the design, and the finish selected. Our in-house manufacturing facility means we can offer superior quality at competitive prices compared to imported flat-pack alternatives. Hettich-endorsed hardware, which we include as standard, adds longevity and smooth operation that off-the-shelf fittings simply cannot match in your Deepdene kitchen.

Benchtops represent the second-largest expense, with prices varying dramatically based on material choice. Laminate benchtops start from around $500 per lineal metre, while engineered stone like Caesarstone or Essastone ranges from $800 to $1,500 per lineal metre installed. Premium natural stone such as marble or granite can exceed $2,000 per lineal metre. For a typical Deepdene kitchen with approximately 4 to 6 lineal metres of benchtop space, expect to budget between $3,000 and $10,000 for this element alone. Our Deepdene showroom displays a wide selection of benchtop materials so you can see and touch each option before committing to your renovation.

Labour and installation costs in Melbourne's inner east typically run between $5,000 and $15,000 for a full kitchen renovation. This covers demolition of the existing kitchen, plumbing modifications, electrical work, cabinetry installation, benchtop fitting, splashback tiling, and painting. Deepdene's heritage housing stock sometimes presents additional challenges such as uneven floors, outdated wiring, or load-bearing walls that require engineering assessments. At Total Support, our qualified in-house tradespeople handle all of these elements, eliminating the stress of coordinating multiple subcontractors and ensuring every trade meets our rigorous quality standards.

Many Deepdene homeowners also ask about the timeline for a kitchen renovation. A cosmetic refresh involving repainting, a new benchtop, and hardware replacement can be completed in 2 to 3 weeks. A full kitchen renovation involving new cabinetry, a reconfigured layout, and updated plumbing and electrical typically takes 6 to 10 weeks from demolition to completion. Our project management team provides a detailed schedule upfront, and we pride ourselves on completing projects on time. Melbourne's building permit requirements may also apply if structural changes are involved, and our team guides you through the entire process including any council submissions required by Boroondara City Council.

The best way to determine the exact cost of your Deepdene kitchen renovation is to book a complimentary design consultation at our showroom. During this session, our team will assess your space, discuss your requirements, and provide a detailed, no-obligation quote. We have been helping Deepdene families create their dream kitchens for over 15 years, and we understand the unique character of homes in this area. Whether you are updating a period property on Deepdene Road or modernising a contemporary apartment, we will tailor a solution that maximises your investment and transforms your daily living experience in the kitchen.

blogPosts.title: Why Australian-Made Kitchen Cabinetry Is Worth the Investment for Deepdene Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover why Deepdene homeowners are choosing locally manufactured cabinetry over imported alternatives for quality, durability, and long-term value.
body: When planning a kitchen renovation in Deepdene, one of the most significant decisions you will face is where your cabinetry is manufactured. While imported flat-pack options from overseas may appear cheaper upfront, Australian-made cabinetry offers compelling advantages that Deepdene homeowners increasingly recognise. At Total Support Kitchen and Home Renovation, we manufacture all our cabinetry in-house at our Melbourne workshop, giving us and you complete control over materials, construction quality, and finishing standards. For Deepdene's discerning homeowners, this local manufacturing difference is immediately apparent in the final product that sits in your kitchen.

Quality materials form the foundation of superior cabinetry. Australian manufacturers are held to strict standards regarding timber sourcing, formaldehyde emissions, and structural integrity. Our in-house workshop uses premium-grade Australian plantation timber and moisture-resistant boards specifically engineered for Melbourne's variable climate. Deepdene experiences everything from hot, dry summers to cool, damp winters, and cabinetry must withstand these fluctuations without warping, swelling, or deteriorating. Imported alternatives often use inferior materials that may look acceptable initially but degrade significantly within five to ten years, particularly in Melbourne's eastern suburbs where humidity levels can fluctuate considerably throughout the year.

The construction method matters enormously when it comes to kitchen cabinetry longevity. Our cabinets are built using traditional joinery techniques enhanced by modern precision machinery, creating joints that are significantly stronger than the cam-and-dowel systems used in flat-pack imports. This means your drawers will not wobble, doors will not sag, and shelves will not bow under the weight of your dinnerware and cookware. Every cabinet we produce in our Melbourne workshop undergoes rigorous quality inspection before leaving the factory floor. For Deepdene homeowners who view their kitchen as a long-term investment in their property, this construction quality translates directly into decades of reliable daily use.

Customisation is another key advantage of choosing locally manufactured cabinetry for your Deepdene kitchen. Unlike imported systems limited to standard sizes, our in-house manufacturing allows us to build cabinets to any dimension, accommodating the unique quirks of Deepdene's diverse housing stock. Whether you have unusual ceiling heights, angled walls characteristic of period homes, or need to work around existing structural elements, Australian-made custom cabinetry can be precision-engineered to fit perfectly. This level of personalisation ensures no space is wasted and every centimetre of your kitchen works harder for you and your family.

Hettich endorsement sets our cabinetry apart from both local and imported competitors in the Deepdene market. Hettich, one of the world's leading hardware manufacturers, endorses our workshop for meeting their exacting standards in hardware integration. This means every hinge, drawer runner, and soft-close mechanism in your Deepdene kitchen is not only premium quality but has been tested and approved by the industry's most respected name. The result is cabinetry that operates with whisper-quiet smoothness and is backed by comprehensive warranties. When you choose Total Support's Australian-made cabinetry, you are getting hardware performance that imported alternatives simply cannot replicate.

The long-term value proposition of Australian-made cabinetry is clear for Deepdene property owners. Quality kitchen renovations consistently rank among the highest-return home improvements, and buyers in Melbourne's inner east specifically look for evidence of quality craftsmanship during inspections. Custom cabinetry manufactured locally signals to future buyers that no shortcuts were taken in the renovation. Combined with the durability advantages, reduced maintenance costs, and the satisfaction of supporting local Australian manufacturing, investing in Australian-made cabinetry for your Deepdene kitchen renovation is a decision that pays dividends for years to come. Visit our showroom to see and feel the difference for yourself.

blogPosts.title: The Complete Guide to Planning a Kitchen Renovation in Deepdene's Heritage Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Expert advice for Deepdene homeowners navigating kitchen renovations in period properties, from council requirements to smart design solutions.
body: Deepdene is renowned for its beautiful heritage homes, from elegant Edwardian residences to stunning Art Deco apartments. Renovating a kitchen in these period properties requires a thoughtful approach that respects the home's original character while delivering modern functionality. At Total Support Kitchen and Home Renovation, we have completed numerous kitchen projects in Deepdene's heritage streetscapes, and we understand the unique challenges and opportunities these homes present. Whether your property is on Deepdene Road, Victoria Road, or one of the charming side streets, our team has the experience to navigate every aspect of a heritage kitchen renovation with care and precision.

The first consideration for any heritage kitchen renovation in Deepdene is understanding council requirements. Boroondara City Council has specific guidelines regarding renovations to properties within heritage overlays, which may affect everything from window placement to exterior visible materials. While internal kitchen renovations typically face fewer restrictions than external alterations, any changes that impact the building's structure or street-facing elements will require a permit. Our team at Total Support has extensive experience working within Boroondara's planning framework and can guide you through the permit process, ensuring your renovation complies with all local regulations while achieving your design objectives for the kitchen.

Heritage homes in Deepdene often present practical challenges that modern builds do not encounter during kitchen renovations. Uneven floors, irregular wall angles, limited natural light, and outdated electrical wiring are common issues we address on a regular basis. Many period kitchens were designed for a completely different style of living, with small, compartmentalised layouts that do not suit contemporary open-plan preferences. Our design team specialises in reimagining these spaces, finding creative solutions that open up the kitchen while preserving the character features that make Deepdene homes so desirable. Sometimes this means revealing original brickwork, restoring timber details, or incorporating period-appropriate design elements alongside modern conveniences.

Plumbing and electrical considerations are particularly important in heritage kitchen renovations throughout Deepdene. Many period homes still have original galvanised plumbing and wiring that does not meet current Australian Standards or handle modern appliance loads safely. A comprehensive kitchen renovation is the ideal time to upgrade these essential services, preventing future problems and ensuring your new kitchen operates safely and efficiently for years to come. Our licensed plumbers and electricians assess the existing infrastructure as part of the design process, identifying any upgrades required and incorporating them into your project budget. This proactive approach avoids costly surprises during the renovation and gives you complete peace of mind.

Storage is often the biggest challenge in heritage kitchen renovations across Deepdene. Original kitchens in period homes were designed before the era of modern appliances and extensive pantry requirements that families expect today. Our custom cabinetry solutions maximise every available centimetre, incorporating clever storage innovations like pull-out pantry systems, corner carousel units, and integrated appliance garages that keep countertops clear. We design cabinetry that complements the proportions and style of your heritage home, using materials and finishes that bridge the gap between period charm and contemporary performance. The result is a kitchen that feels both timeless and thoroughly modern, perfectly suited to how your family actually lives in Deepdene.

Timing your heritage kitchen renovation in Deepdene requires careful planning and early engagement with your chosen renovation team. Melbourne's building industry typically experiences peak demand from February through to November, with quieter periods during summer and over the Christmas break. Heritage renovations often take longer than standard projects due to the additional care required and potential council approval timelines. We recommend beginning the design and planning phase at least three to four months before your desired start date. Contact Total Support Kitchen and Home Renovation to book a design consultation and discover how we can transform your Deepdene heritage kitchen into a space that honours the past while embracing the future.

blogPosts.title: How to Choose the Perfect Kitchen Benchtop Material for Your Deepdene Renovation
blogPosts.excerpt: Compare laminate, engineered stone, natural stone, and timber benchtops for your Deepdene kitchen renovation with durability, cost, and style analysed.
body: Choosing the right benchtop material is one of the most impactful decisions you will make during a kitchen renovation in Deepdene. Your benchtop is the workhorse of the kitchen, needing to withstand daily use, resist stains and heat, and still look beautiful for years to come. With so many options available, from affordable laminates to luxurious natural stones, making the right choice can feel overwhelming. At Total Support Kitchen and Home Renovation, our Deepdene showroom displays an extensive range of benchtop materials, allowing you to see, touch, and compare each option before making a decision that suits your lifestyle and renovation budget.

Laminate benchtops remain the most affordable option for Deepdene homeowners, starting from approximately $500 per lineal metre installed. Modern laminates have improved dramatically in recent years, with realistic stone and timber-look finishes that are difficult to distinguish from the genuine article at first glance. They are resistant to most stains, easy to clean, and available in hundreds of colours and patterns to match any kitchen design. However, laminate is susceptible to heat damage from hot pans, can chip at the edges, and cannot be repaired if deeply scratched. For budget-conscious renovations or investment properties in Deepdene, quality laminate offers excellent value and a surprisingly premium appearance.

Engineered stone, including popular brands like Caesarstone and Essastone, has become the benchtop material of choice for most Deepdene kitchen renovations. Priced between $800 and $1,500 per lineal metre installed, engineered stone offers the beauty of natural stone with significantly improved durability and colour consistency. It is non-porous, meaning it resists staining without requiring regular sealing, and it is highly resistant to scratches and everyday heat. Available in a vast range of colours from crisp whites to dramatic darks, engineered stone suits virtually any kitchen design style. For Deepdene's family homes, where the kitchen sees heavy daily use, engineered stone provides the ideal balance of aesthetics, performance, and long-term value.

Natural stone benchtops, including marble, granite, and quartzite, represent the premium end of the market for Deepdene's luxury kitchen renovations. Prices typically range from $1,500 to $3,000 or more per lineal metre installed, depending on the stone variety and complexity of the fabrication and edge detailing. Marble offers unmatched elegance with its distinctive veining, though it requires regular sealing and is susceptible to etching from acidic substances like lemon juice. Granite is exceptionally hard-wearing and heat-resistant, making it practical as well as beautiful for busy Deepdene kitchens. Each slab of natural stone is unique, giving your kitchen a one-of-a-kind focal point. Our showroom displays several natural stone options so you can select the exact slab for your project.

Timber and butcher's block benchtops bring warmth and natural beauty to Deepdene kitchens, particularly those in heritage or Scandinavian-inspired designs. Priced from $600 to $1,200 per lineal metre installed, timber benchtops require more maintenance than stone alternatives, with regular oiling essential to prevent drying and cracking over time. However, many Deepdene homeowners love the way timber develops a rich patina over the years, telling the story of meals prepared and memories made around the family kitchen. Timber is also more forgiving on dropped dishes than stone, making it a practical choice for busy family kitchens with young children. We source sustainably harvested Australian timbers including blackbutt, spotted gum, and Tasmanian oak for our custom benchtops.

The best benchtop for your Deepdene kitchen renovation ultimately depends on how you use your kitchen, your aesthetic preferences, and your budget. There is no universally right answer, as a young family might prioritise the durability of engineered stone while a couple who rarely cooks might prefer the luxury of marble as a statement piece. Our complimentary design consultations at the Deepdene showroom include benchtop selection guidance, where we will walk you through samples, discuss maintenance requirements, and help you find the perfect match for your lifestyle. Visit Total Support Kitchen and Home Renovation to explore our full benchtop display and start creating your ideal kitchen in Deepdene.
